node.title: Re: Privilege reduction with start_server / plackup
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext: You should not need to use start_server ... --plackup to run a FastCGI setup in production. Use a standard web server, all of them support FastCGI. Plack is the FastCGI "glue" for Perl that enables you to connect with it, but the command-line is intended for offline testing purposes.
